conflicts.description: ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 1 explicitly lists Course Details among the screens that keep the bottom nav visible ("still 'browsing,' not 'doing'"). The showcase's own Course Details mobile frame (lines 2117-2156) does not render a bottom-nav row at all — the frame's fixed 788px height is fully consumed by a header row (back/bookmark/share icons), the scrolling hero+tabs+description+instructor content, and a sticky footer bar (price + "Enroll now", lines 2150-2153), leaving no room for a 64px nav row in this specific illustration.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved in favor of rank-1 (ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 1): the bottom nav stays present per the locked rule; the showcase's omission is read as a space/illustration constraint of this one 788px mockup (which also omits the status bar's usual top padding seen elsewhere), not a deliberate 'hide nav here' instruction — Course Details is never listed anywhere alongside Course Player/Quiz's explicit hide rule. An implementer should render both the sticky CTA bar AND the bottom nav (stacked, CTA bar directly above the nav) rather than treating this as a Course-Player-style full-hide screen.

layout.structure: single scrolling column: header icon row (back, bookmark, share — no page title in the showcase's own header, lines 2120-2125) -> 16:9 hero with center play affordance -> category chip + title + rating/students/duration meta row -> Overview/Curriculum/Instructor tabs -> tab body copy -> instructor summary card -> sticky footer (price + Enroll/Continue CTA)
layout.adaptation: content hierarchy matches Web's course-details.json (hero -> description -> curriculum -> instructor) but the CTA is STICKY at the bottom of the viewport on mobile (ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 4), unlike Web's inline CTA

content: arrow_back icon, bookmark icon, ios_share icon — no title text in this header row (lines 2120-2125)
16:9 thumbnail with a centered play_arrow affordance overlay (lines 2127-2129) — a play-preview treatment not present on Web's course-details.json hero
category chip/badge, title (heading.h1-ish, showcase font:700 26px/33px), rating + student count + duration row (lines 2131-2137)
Overview | Curriculum | Instructor — 3 tabs, not Web's 2 (lines 2138-2142); ux/SCREEN_UX_SPECS.md § 3 governs actual tab content per rank-1 if this differs from Web's own 2-tab structure
body copy under the active tab (line 2143)
compact InstructorCard: avatar initials + name + "{title} · {course count} courses" (lines 2144-2147)

price + "Demo price" caption, full-width "Enroll now" PrimaryButton (lines 2150-2153) — sticky per ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 4, replaced by a Continue-Learning affordance once enrolled (inferred from Web's equivalent state, not separately shown in this specific mockup)

knownGaps: No mobile Arabic-RTL or Dark-mode frame exists in the showcase for Course Details — rtlBehavior/themeBehavior above are inferred from the general locked rules, not independently showcase-verified for this screen.

This mobile frame shows a 3-tab (Overview/Curriculum/Instructor) structure, differing from course-details.json's Web description of exactly 2 tabs implied elsewhere in this pipeline for other editor-style screens — ux/SCREEN_UX_SPECS.md § 3 is the actual rank-1 authority for whichever tab count is correct; this spec records what the showcase visually shows without asserting it overrides rank-1 if a conflict is later found there.

No student-count/duration meta fields are fabricated beyond what course-details.json (Web) already discloses as a real data gap — this mobile spec inherits that same disclosed limitation, not a new one.
